leadStory: As of Tuesday evening, Mundo Deportivo (via Goal) and Sports Mole report Real Madrid weighing a free transfer for Virgil van Dijk, whose Liverpool contract ends in summer 2027 with no renewal offered; Gakpo's ankle remains ungraded twelve days before Manchester City at Anfield.
note: No Track 2 request this edition. The lead is a contract report from Spain, not a single Liverpool still. Antigravity should take no action.
